interpretationDecisions.decision: The three selected Level-1 takes at80.1,464.05 and1070.85 use crouching MP into standing HK, confirmed by full input glyphs and kick animation. Other selected crouching-MP target branches visibly use HP; no global button substitution.

No numeric +F value becomes an invented wait. Intentional LK/cr.LP/medium-knee whiffs appear in copied notation. Only visibly delayed throws and captioned delayed pickups retain unquantified timing cues.
Greedy setup prerequisites require the standing-only knockdown. Mighty follow-ups leave Ryu standing on hit, so those are Pressure without Oki. No hit sequence is mislabeled as a blocked string.
Full-resolution live input at113.5 identifies jumping heavy punch with back direction, then landing guard against recorded Ryu OD Shoryuken. No universal reversal safety.

Full six-bar starting HUD observed at1129.8. One raw Rush plus two cancel Rushes nominally sum to seven; the final cancel spends remaining Drive and enters burnout. No seven-bar gauge capacity or current-patch requirement is invented.
Source225.65–239.4 keeps the input history neutral after activation. This is distinct from the still-unprocessed directional follow-up routes later in the source.
Corner whiff-LK/medium follow-up resolves the caption’s any to the visible heavy knee and medium uppercut, including the yellow medium-punch glyph at400.0.
